usedCounterFrames: flow-ch01 counter must target this misread: Turn the opening into generic anti-materialism or gratitude advice.
flow-ch02 counter must target this misread: Flatten psychic entropy into ordinary stress or make the chapter into focus-hack productivity advice.
flow-ch03 counter must target this misread: Make pleasure the villain or reduce enjoyment to excitement.
flow-ch04 counter must target this misread: Treat flow as equally available everywhere if someone has the right attitude.
flow-ch05 counter must target this misread: Reduce the body chapter to fitness motivation, indulgence, or wellness slogans.
flow-ch06 counter must target this misread: Turn intellectual flow into study tips, credential worship, or vague curiosity praise.
flow-ch07 counter must target this misread: Romanticize all jobs or tell exploited workers to enjoy bad conditions.
flow-ch08 counter must target this misread: Say people just need more connection or more alone time.
flow-ch09 counter must target this misread: Claim tragedy is secretly good or that resilient people simply choose the right attitude.
flow-ch10 counter must target this misread: Collapse meaning into vague purpose slogans or personal branding.
usedTryThisNowFrames: flow-ch01 try action: Name one upgrade you keep expecting to make life feel settled, then write the experience it is supposed to create and one way to practice that experience today.
flow-ch02 try action: Pick the one open loop pulling hardest on your attention, write the next visible action it needs, and remove one competing cue from sight.
flow-ch03 try action: Take one easy leisure habit and add a clear target, a difficulty notch, and immediate feedback before you do it next.
flow-ch04 try action: Choose one task you avoid and add one visible goal, one feedback cue, and one boundary that makes the first ten minutes easier to enter.
flow-ch05 try action: Choose one ordinary bodily act, walking, stretching, tasting, or listening, and give it one precise cue to track for sixty seconds.
flow-ch06 try action: Turn one vague curiosity into a playable question, then write the rule for what counts as progress in the next ten minutes.
flow-ch07 try action: Pick one work task you resent, name the feedback it currently hides, and add one visible checkpoint before the next attempt.
flow-ch08 try action: Before your next alone or social hour, write the one shared or solitary task that will give attention a shape.
flow-ch09 try action: Name one current disruption, draw two columns for cannot control and can order next, then do the smallest visible item in the second column.
flow-ch10 try action: Write three activities that absorb you, then finish this sentence: together, these are training me to serve or build what?
usedQuizExplanationFrames: flow-ch01 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Stop treating improved circumstances as the route to happiness and identify where inner order must be built directly.

flow-ch02 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Treat attention as a limited organizing force and move it from scattered demands toward one chosen goal with feedback.

flow-ch03 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Convert a merely pleasant activity into an enjoyable one by adding challenge, clear goals, and feedback that make the activity worth doing for itself.

flow-ch04 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Look past motivation and redesign the conditions that make goals, feedback, challenge, and engagement easier to enter.

flow-ch05 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Turn bodily sensation into skilled involvement by giving the body rhythm, challenge, control, and trained attention.

flow-ch06 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Give thinking a playable structure: a real question, symbolic rules, visible progress, and a next move that keeps curiosity active.

flow-ch07 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Redesign a work task so it answers back with challenge and feedback instead of waiting for leisure to supply all meaning.

flow-ch08 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Handle alone time and social time as skills, choosing the structure that turns isolation or contact into ordered experience.

flow-ch09 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: When disorder arrives, separate the uncontrollable blow from the next controllable ordering move and rebuild attention around that move.

flow-ch10 explanations must compare a concrete transfer scenario against the chapter-specific move: Link separate absorbing activities into a life theme by choosing the purpose they serve and the commitments that keep them from scattering.
